verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is documented as API-first. Its API covers most of the banking lifecycle: account opening and KYC, ACH, wires, book transfers and FedNow, card issuance through deactivation, disputes, account locking and closure, statements, 1099s, and full webhook CRUD. However, the evidence never states UI/API parity, and API key creation is described as a Developer Sandbox dashboard action rather than an API call. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, programmatic API key management, a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent corroboration that no actions are dashboard-only.
